soundness_flags.label: oeq:certified-implementation
soundness_flags.one_line: “Every floating-point execution” and “polynomial-time” are undefined without a floating-point/exponent model, input encoding and cost model, and certified access specification for the normal and chi-square quantiles.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Statistical theorem suite
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Known fixed rank and variance, exact rank and span restrictions, square strong donors, Gaussian independent blocks, incoherence, and bounded entries are maintained rather than derived.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: All statistical headline claims are conditional on the stated strong-donor Gaussian class \(\mathcal P_n\); they do not claim rank adaptation, approximate-factor, weak-donor, dependent-noise, or realized-outcome inference.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 1 requires its local incoherence/loading conditions for Gaussian approximation; Lemma 8 explicitly removes lower bound (4.4c) but only provides the decomposition and approximation, not an all-loading interval.

The minimum-distance result assumes a uniformly asymptotically normal primitive estimator, well-conditioned covariance, and a consistent covariance estimator, then gives uniform validity in its specified quadratic-transformation regimes.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 4–5, low-rank factor model; p. 10, discussion directing bilinear CIs to Appendix C
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper treats low-rank panel counterfactual inference and directs arbitrary bilinear-form confidence intervals to Appendix C; it is an adjacent operational comparator rather than a source for the proposed transition theorem.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Specify IEEE-754 or an equivalent directed-rounding model, bounded/exact input representation, treatment of overflow/subnormals, and a certified polynomial-time oracle or enclosure algorithm for \(\Phi^{-1}\) and \(F^{-1}_{\chi^2}\) in the finite-precision OEQ.

Add a worked rank-one joint-zero numerical certificate showing the outward SVD, gate, and quantile padding is \(o(n^{-1})\) under the chosen bit model; this makes the implementation target concretely testable before its general proof.
Sharpen the local lower bound toward a matching leading constant or characterize when the analytic interval is locally asymptotically minimax, not merely constant-factor transition-optimal.

recommended_next_step: Revise the certified-implementation OEQ with an explicit numerical-computation model, then advance the otherwise field-grade transition-inference kernel to Stage 0.
